user_query: I'm planning a surprise party for my sister's graduation. Can you provide me with some inspirational quotes and suggest some unique party ideas? Also, find me a list of available phone numbers to send out the party invitations.

TaskList.description: Fetch a set of inspirational quotes related to graduation.
Generate a list of unique party ideas that reflect a graduation theme.
Retrieve a list of available phone numbers for people to invite to the party.
